source.notes: Natural-language prompts for smart-contract generation experimentation. Mirrors nl2sysml/dataset.json.

prompts.description: Create an ERC20-style token contract named SimpleToken with a fixed supply minted to the deployer, transfer and approve/transferFrom, and Transfer/Approval events.
Design an Escrow contract holding funds for a buyer and seller with an arbiter that can release funds to the seller or refund the buyer.
Model a Voting contract where an owner registers proposals and whitelisted voters cast one vote each; expose the winning proposal.
Create a MultiSigWallet requiring M-of-N owner confirmations before executing a queued transaction.
Specify a Crowdsale contract that sells tokens at a fixed rate during a time window and forwards raised ETH to a wallet.
